title: Holy shit. My people.
content: I’ve been dreaming of Mallworld for YEARS. I have a big fascination with liminal spaces and dead malls as a stereotypical Millennial. I am AuDHD so I have synesthesia like crazy. I “see” and “feel” random spaces in my mind during normal trains of thought (which are also abstract as fuck; I do not think in words) and often I have no real control over what space I feel/see. This continues when I dream. I never used to have repeated dreams, but the last few years, I do. The one most relevant to this sub is, in fact, a super huge mall. It has multiple floors and lots of pink design. There are a lot of vacuum repair stores (I have no clue why; this is not relevant to my life at all) and other spaces that seem to be on the verge of extinction in the real world. I dream about climbing the levels in the mall. I stand in the atrium with the fountain and lots of plants and look up, up, up. There’s a glass ceiling way up high but I can’t really see it. There are rows of stores. Sometimes, parts of the mall are dead. Like the parts of it exist in different times but I can travel through them all. Anyway. Finding this sub was kind of serendipitous. Glad to be here.
